truth.description: formatBuiltAsset no longer writes an asset's query or hash after the __VITE_ASSET__ token but keeps it under a urlId that, among the token's readers, only renderAssetUrlInJS and the CSS chunk replacement look up, while the HTML plugin, which gets that token for every asset URL in index.html through urlToBuiltUrl and fileToBuiltUrl, still replaces it with the bare output path in generateBundle, so a built page loses the fragment or query of each such reference and points at the whole sprite.

distractions.why: The file name handed to renderBuiltUrl now carries the asset's query or hash, which is what the ticket asks for, and the postfix is looked up by the urlId Rolldown passes to resolveFileUrl, so a reference without one appends an empty string.

The postfix joins the file name before importedAssets records it, but cleanUrl strips the query and hash there, so the recorded name is still the emitted file and only the rendered URL keeps the postfix.
